method: Batch 37. Same double, row layout, script ops and record fields as village-fight-b36-reference.json, plus: the script op `t spawnspider x z y yaw` (a spider placed, World.spawnEntityInWorld, then EntitySpider.onSpawnWithEgg(null): the 1-in-100 skeleton jockey on World.rand, then on Hard the potion effect when nextFloat < 0.1 * the regional difficulty, the record field `local`, which the probe World.func_147462_b answers) and `t hitmob k dmg player|mob` (a hit on the k-th spider or skeleton the fight built); `mobs` lists them as [tick, 0 spider / 1 skeleton, x, y, z, Entity.rand seed, yaw, index of the mount among them, movement speed, health]; row element 7 is each of them as [x, y, z, health, target, revenge, Entity.rand draws of the tick]. The b37-chicken-wander records are chicken wanders on the probe floor (stone below y 0), some over a grass patch; their `searches` give the native path finder point counts.
